description: This PHP class 'Dependent' extends 'NormalizableDTO' and represents a Data Transfer Object (DTO) for handling employee dependent data within the OrangeHRM reporting system. It provides methods for converting dependent data to an array format and defines mappings for retrieving specific fields related to dependents.

classes.name: Dependent
classes.description: A DTO class for employee dependents, providing methods to generate a normalized array of dependents' data for reporting or processing purposes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Dependent DTO with an employee number.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the employee's dependents to an array based on specified fields.

methods.name: getFieldGetterMap
methods.description: Returns a mapping of field names to getter methods used to extract dependent information.
